text: 金十数据9月15日讯，宁德时代公告，公司全资子公司宁波问鼎拟作为有限合伙人参与投资厦门时代怡远创业投资基金合伙企业，认缴出资11.2亿元，持有基金19.4175%的认缴比例。公司控股股东厦门瑞庭亦作为有限合伙人参与该基金投资，因此本次投资构成关联共同投资。厦门瑞庭目前持有公司10.2亿股A股股份，占公司总股本的22.04%。
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 15 — CATL announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary Ningbo Wending plans to participate as a limited partner in investing in Xiamen Shidai Yiyuan Venture Capital Fund Partnership, with a subscribed capital contribution of 1.12 billion yuan, holding a 19.4175% subscribed share of the fund. The company's controlling shareholder Xiamen Ruiting will also participate as a limited partner in the fund's investment, so this investment constitutes a related-party co-investment. Xiamen Ruiting currently holds 1.02 billion A-share shares of the company, accounting for 22.04% of the company's total share capital.
